exposure: post-partum risk intervals (0-1 days, 2-6 days, 7-13 days, 14-41 days, 42-122 days, and 4-11 months)
cohort: The cohort comprised 647,104 childbirths from women aged 10-54 years across 30 Health and Demographic Surveillance System sites in 12 sub-Saharan African countries, occurring from 1991 onwards.
finding: The risk of death for women remains significantly elevated up to four months post-partum (20% higher risk between 42 days and 4 months post-partum), suggesting that the current WHO 42-day threshold for pregnancy-related mortality may underestimate the full duration of risk.
